correctness.rationale: Mandatory de Bruijn edge imbalance is computed exactly; the specified extra edge set cancels it; alternating bridge paths make the augmented graph strongly connected and Eulerian. The potential minus the first equal-pair index has edge increment at most one on the entire binary de Bruijn graph. Its exact tightness on every added edge makes a global circulation lower bound match the Euler tour. Two elementary Fibonacci composition counts complete the formula for all k>=3. Reproducible finite witnesses, balance, potential checks, and separate full-graph minimum-cost-flow optimization corroborate rather than substitute for this proof.

value.rationale: The symmetric prohibition of 000 and 111 is a canonical nontrivial run-length constrained language. The theorem determines a sharp minimum all-factor circular cover for every window length, including the exact unavoidable repetitions, a constructive Eulerian optimum, and a global lower bound robust to forbidden windows in the host. It is not merely a recurrence or a numerical table.
